Definition: Claiming that one step will inevitably lead to an extreme outcome, without showing why each step must follow. A possible concern is treated as a certain chain reaction.
Example: A parent hears, 'If we let him stay up ten minutes later tonight, soon he will never follow any bedtime at all.'
FaithDiscussionExample: Someone warns, 'If you question one interpretation of a passage, soon you will not believe anything in the Bible,' without showing why careful study must lead there.
HowToRespond: Acknowledge the underlying concern, then ask for the links in the chain: 'I share your desire to stay faithful — can we look step by step at what actually follows?'
